name: cTSPersistResKeyList::Commit
notes: Slot 4, ret 4, EH frame (the frame's own handler address rules out byte matching). Persist system from GetServiceObject slot 5 (0x056b906e, 0x9af5e924), its slot 16 SaveResource(persist face or 0, segment), then slot 10 of the given segment, else persist slot 34 FindSegment(key from GetKey through the +4 face's vtable, 0x656b8f0c, &segment) and its slot 10; the found segment is released, and the persist system with RZAutoRef::ReleaseObject (also when a call throws). Standalone shape (DW): the hook is an adapter; the difftest calls our object's own slot 4, GetKey recorded through a copy of the object's own persist vtable. Test PersistResKeyList_Commit: 160 cases over save / flush / find answers (upper bits noise), a given or missing segment, find setting its out on failure, and C++ throws from the save and the flush. Not tested: a null service or a null segment out on a true find (both crash in the original). Mutants: GetKey bypassed for the member (DW, killed); segment dropped from the save call, found segment not released, persist system not released, wrong segment id (CE, killed). In effect through its callers (lane GP): the adapter and its hook are gone; only the game's vtable slots reference the original (and original code reached only through them), and no object carries those vtables while the hook cTSPersistResKeyList_Create is in, so the host traps the original under that switch.

name: cTSPersistResKeyList::Read
notes: Serial face slot 4, ret 4, EH frame. First word 0xdeadbeef: version (slot 8) and count follow, else the word is the count (version 0); the key vector is resized to the count (vector::resize reproduces the original's 0x1f4b70 / 0x1f4ce0 instantiations, growth included); per key three words and, from version 2 (signed compare), the high word; one stack word is reused for every read; the mapper's slot 11 (key, zeroed out key) replaces the key when it answers true. The first word, version and count are uninitialised stack words in the original when their read fails: ours start at zero and the test never fails them. Standalone shape (DW): the hook is an adapter; the difftest calls our object's own serial slot 4. Test PersistResKeyList_Read: 1920 cases. Mutants: the adapter dispatching virtually (DW, killed: the trap vtable); high word from version 3, count capped, mapped key always taken, version through slot 9, record not released (CE, killed). In effect through its callers (lane GP): the adapter and its hook are gone; only the game's vtable slots reference the original (and original code reached only through them), and no object carries those vtables while the hook cTSPersistResKeyList_Create is in, so the host traps the original under that switch.
